{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u052/system/state/workspace/programs/task-24521b8f.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Tile each colored seed patch across its enclosing non-8 rectangular region."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r0 in range(h):
        for c0 in range(w):
            if grid[r0][c0] == 8 or (r0, c0) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r0, c0)]
            seen.add((r0, c0))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                r, c = stack.pop()
                cells.append((r, c))
                for nr, nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] != 8 and (nr,nc) not in seen:
                        seen.add((nr,nc))
                        stack.append((nr,nc))
            colored = [(r,c) for r,c in cells if grid[r][c] not in (0,8)]
            if not colored:
                continue
            top, bottom = min(r for r,c in colored), max(r for r,c in colored)
            left, right = min(c for r,c in colored), max(c for r,c in colored)
            th, tw = bottom-top+1, right-left+1
            region_top = min(r for r,c in cells)
            region_bottom = max(r for r,c in cells)
            region_left = min(c for r,c in cells)
            region_right = max(c for r,c in cells)
            tile = [grid[r][left:right+1] for r in range(top,bottom+1)]
            for r in range(region_top, region_bottom+1):
                for c in range(region_left, region_right+1):
                    out[r][c] = tile[(r-top) % th][(c-left) % tw]
    return out
"
}
